description: Returns the most recent CAP (Common Alerting Protocol) weather warnings issued by AEMET for the given autonomous community, or for the whole country ('esp'). Severity follows the CAP standard: Minor, Moderate, Severe, Extreme.

area.description: Spanish autonomous community: name ('Cataluña', 'Madrid', 'La Rioja'), 2-digit AEMET code (61-78), or 'esp' for national.

language.description: Preferred warning language (default 'es'). 'any' returns the first available.

minSeverity.description: Only return warnings at or above this severity.

name: get_warnings
title: Active CAP weather warnings for a Spanish region
